text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling stocks just because they were above my average cost brought satisfaction, but those gains alone do not show that selling was the right decision; weigh each holding’s prospects and role in the portfolio.","I often left positions untouched after declines, while buying again after rises. Neither recent price movement nor my purchase price predicts what comes next, so reassess each stock consistently rather than anchoring on either.","Account value fluctuated despite my trades, a reminder that frequent activity is not necessarily helpful. Keep decisions aligned with risk, diversification, and long-term goals instead of reacting to monthly changes."]}
